description: Look up a symbol by symbol_id or FQN and return its source code. Use instead of Read when you need one specific function/class/method — returns only the symbol, not the whole file. For multiple symbols at once, prefer get_context_bundle. Read-only. Returns JSON: { symbol_id, name, kind, fqn, signature, file, line_start, line_end, source }.

fqn.description: The fully qualified name to look up

max_lines.description: Truncate source to this many lines (omit for full source)

verify_against_git.description: Compare the indexed source against the current git HEAD slice; mismatches set `git_mismatch: true` in the response (index may be stale). Read-only. Silently skipped when git is unavailable or the file is untracked.

name: get_symbol
